blocks.text: The Step2 Flip Seat provides comfort and convenience in every circumstance. This portable seat improves your outdoor experience whether you're at the pool, beach, or camping. Its innovative design ensures maximum comfort, letting you relax and appreciate your surroundings. The unique lip securely hooks the seat to pool edges, docks, and tailgates, giving stability without slipping. Enjoy the water while keeping outstanding back support. This seat also converts a five-gallon bucket into an elevated seat, giving you mobility. It's lightweight, easy to store, and made to last with long-lasting colors. Upgrade your comfort and mobility with Step2 Flip Seat today! It's not just flexible; it's also your go-to beach friend and a game-changer for camping comfort. The seat neatly splits in half to see a built-in handle for easy portability. No assembly and is ready to use straight away. It has a strong frame, a solid thru-axle, and a stainless-steel lock nut. The hues are sculpted into the surface, assuring long-lasting beauty. Remember that, while the Step2 Flip Seat is quite comfortable, it is not intended for floating. Prioritize safety and use it appropriately for your activities.

items.label: VERSATILE DESIGN
items.value: Relax and appreciate your surroundings with Step2’s Flip Seat. Built-in lip in front helps the seat stay in place at the edge of the pool, at the beach, at the campsite, and more. Molded-in detail on the bottom helps you combine the Flip Seat and 5-gallon bucket into a comfy chair

items.label: ERGONOMIC
items.value: Constructed for optimal back/lumbar support while providing comfy seating while sitting on the ground. Each Flip Seat holds up to 300lbs, with the assembled dimensions measuring 20.5" H x 19" W x 21.5" D

items.label: MAINTENANCE FREE
items.value: No assembly required, just unbox and flip open to enjoy portable seating anytime, anywhere. Solid through axle and stainless-steel lock nuts provide a secure, worry-free design for years to come

items.label: PORTABLE
items.value: Each Flip Seat weighs only 9.25 lbs., with an easy-to-carry cutout handle when folded. The space-saving design makes it easy to store at home or in the car, ensuring your comfy seat stays travel-friendly

items.label: DURABLE
items.value: Double-walled plastic construction and 316 marine-grade stainless steel hardware are built-to-last, resist rust and corrosion, and are designed to withstand weather, chlorine, salt water, and sun. Designed for years of use with colors that won't chip, fade, crack, or peel. The resin is UV20 formulated to withstand approximately 20,000 hours of UV exposure

items.label: Additional Features
items.value: Durable, Ergonomic, Foldable, Portable, Weather Proof

items.label: Surface Recommendation
items.value: pool edge, beach, 5 gallon bucket, bleachers, stadiums, dock, cooler, fishing boat

items.value: Camping, Hunting, Pool, Stadium Seating, Tailgaiting
